fields.acceptance: A testscript answers a blocking question, then answers it again and gets exit 2 with no answer-<q>-2 written; a second open question that blocks only another change set, answered with --change <cs>, also exits 2; a question that blocks a capability the change set touches is accepted; fold-ok passes
